class.name: NetwRecord
class.brief_description: The named-value row a persisted or sampled value travels as, and the base a script subclasses to supply its own storage.

method.name: _from_dict
method.description: Populates this record from [param data]. Override it to coerce types or migrate stored names. [codeblock] func _from_dict(data: Dictionary) -> void: set_value(&"health", data.get(&"hp", 100)) [/codeblock]

method.name: _get_property_names
method.description: Returns the property names stored in this record. Override it together with [method _set_value], [method _get_value] and [method _has_value] to supply the storage; [method get_property_names] is what callers use.

method.name: _get_value
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param property], or [param default] if absent. Override it to supply the storage; [method get_value] is what callers use.

method.name: _has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param property] is present. Override it to supply the storage; [method has_value] is what callers use.

method.name: _set_value
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param property]. Override it to supply the storage; [method set_value] is what callers use.

method.name: _to_dict
from_dict
method.description: Populates this record from [param data]. Without a [method _from_dict] override this calls [method set_value] for every key in [param data].

method.name: get_property_names
method.description: Returns the property names stored in this record, in the order the storage holds them. This is the sequence [code]for key in record[/code] walks and the one [method to_dict] reads.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param property], or [param default] if absent.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when no values are stored, which is [method get_property_names] returning nothing.

method.name: to_dict
method.description: Returns this record's data as a plain [Dictionary]. Without a [method _to_dict] override this iterates [method get_property_names] and calls [method get_value] for each key.
